conjunction.overall: This planet is moving through your sign, so its traditional themes receive extra emphasis today.
conjunction.love: This influence is close to your sign and may feel more immediate in relationship matters.
conjunction.work: This influence can make its work-related themes feel more personal and noticeable.
conjunction.money: Its values and resource themes may deserve closer attention today.
conjunction.communication: Its message is close to your sign, making the related thoughts or conversations easier to notice.
conjunction.social: Its social tone may feel more immediate or personally relevant.
conjunction.energy: Its drive can feel close at hand; use it deliberately rather than automatically.
conjunction.advice: Notice where this influence is already asking for your attention.

sextile.overall: This planet forms a supportive whole-sign relationship with your sign, traditionally associated with openings that respond well to participation.
sextile.love: There is a supportive tone here; connection may benefit from a small but intentional effort.
sextile.work: This influence can support progress when you actively use the opportunity rather than waiting for it.
sextile.money: A practical opening may be available, especially when choices remain measured.
sextile.communication: Conversation and exchange may move more easily when you make the first useful step.
sextile.social: Social interaction can feel lighter or more cooperative.
sextile.energy: The energy is supportive without being forceful; initiative still matters.
sextile.advice: Use the opening rather than assuming it will act for you.

square.overall: This planet forms a challenging whole-sign relationship with your sign, traditionally linked with pressure, adjustment and action.
square.love: Relationship themes may need more patience or clearer boundaries than usual.
square.work: Friction can reveal where a plan, expectation or workload needs adjustment.
square.money: Avoid letting pressure turn into an impulsive financial choice.
square.communication: Different priorities may create friction; clarity is more useful than winning the exchange.
square.social: Stronger personalities or conflicting expectations may require tact.
square.energy: There is usable drive here, but it can become impatience if it has no clear direction.
square.advice: Treat tension as information about what needs adjustment.

trine.overall: This planet forms a flowing whole-sign relationship with your sign, traditionally associated with ease and natural support.
trine.love: Relationship themes may feel easier to express or understand.
trine.work: Skills or existing strengths may be easier to use productively.
trine.money: A steadier flow can help, but ease should not replace good judgment.
trine.communication: Ideas and expression may connect more naturally.
trine.social: Social interaction may require less effort than usual.
trine.energy: Motivation may move more naturally when directed toward something constructive.
trine.advice: Use what comes easily today instead of overlooking it.

opposition.overall: This planet sits opposite your sign by whole-sign relationship, traditionally highlighting balance, contrast and other people's perspectives.
opposition.love: Relationship matters may highlight a difference between your needs and another person's.
opposition.work: Competing priorities can make balance and negotiation more important.
opposition.money: A choice may involve balancing immediate wants against another obligation.
opposition.communication: Another viewpoint may be especially visible; listening can be as useful as explaining.
opposition.social: Other people can act as a mirror for what you are emphasizing or overlooking.
opposition.energy: Avoid swinging between extremes; a balanced response is more useful.
opposition.advice: Look at the other side before deciding what the situation means.

neutral.overall: This placement is part of today's background sky but does not form one of the five major whole-sign relationships to your sign.
neutral.love: Its relationship influence is secondary today.
neutral.work: Its work influence is more background than dominant.
neutral.money: Its money influence is secondary today.
neutral.communication: Its communication influence is subtle rather than dominant.
neutral.social: Its social influence remains in the background.
neutral.energy: Its motivational influence is secondary today.
neutral.advice: Keep this influence in perspective rather than forcing a meaning from it.
